summary.zh: 用 Temporal 设计可恢复的长流程与事务
summary.en: Design durable long-running workflows with Temporal

description.zh: 讲清 workflow 与 activity 的职责划分、saga 补偿、状态持久化和确定性约束，并说明哪些场景不该用工作流引擎。适合构建跨服务的长流程、分布式事务或微服务编排时参考。需要可用的 Temporal 服务端。
description.en: Explains workflow versus activity separation, saga compensation, state persistence, and determinism, plus when not to use a workflow engine. Use it for long-running cross-service processes. A Temporal server is required.
